item.title: It’s Sell Off America Time Around the World
item.description: The value of the U.S. dollar dropped against most foreign currencies in late January, while dollar-denominated gold and silver prices rose by record rates.

item.title: Residents Organize Against East Webster Sewer Expansion
item.description: A group of Webster Lake residents opposed to a planned sewer expansion has begun organizing in response to what members describe as rising costs, land-use concerns and a lack of choice for homeowners with functioning septic systems.

item.title: I Want to Sell Firewood; What Do I Need?
item.description: I recently had a request from an individual about what they need to sell firewood legally, and with all the wood stove users and campers out there, I thought this question may have a broader appeal.

item.title: Thaddeus Du Bois To Run For County Council
item.description: Thaddeus Du Bois, a North Webster resident and owner of Thaddeus Landscaping, has entered the race for Kosciusko County Council, citing the East Webster sewer expansion as the issue that compelled him to seek public office.

item.title: Free Beef Quality Assurance Certification Offered in Elkhart County
item.description: Beef, dairy x beef and dairy cattle producers are invited to attend a free Beef Quality Assurance certification program from 5:30-7:30 p.m. Wednesday, Feb. 18, at the Purdue Extension Elkhart County Office, located on the Elkhart County 4-H Fairgrounds, 17746 CR 34, Goshen.

item.title: Wawasee School Board Welcomes Interim Superintendant During February Work Session
item.description: The Wawasee School Board used its February work session to welcome interim superintendent Dr. Diane Woodworth, preview upcoming financial decisions, hear public concerns and review several consulting and operational proposals expected to come before the board for formal approval later this month.
